description: Managing the in-house Java Development Team to offer internal, back of house solutions as well as Customer facing web portals to our Freight Agent community.
Manage the Support Network across our four regions ensuring the end user is supported by local key users or from members of my UK, US and South Pac based teams.
As the senior IT representative in AMI, work closely with the parent company's IT Team around the globe to ensure our business is supported 24/7.
Play a role in the expansion of our network when the business opens up new locations in our regions.
Currently involved in a Data Centre transformation project where applications are being migrated to a new Enterprise Cloud Service with a third party supplier.
Project managing the IT Infrastructure required for our green field Station start-ups for our Joint Ventures in Hyderabad and Bangalore in 2007 and 2008.
Oversaw the implementation of the Network, IT Hardware acquisition and key systems at both of these new Airports up to the go-live in the Spring of 2008.

Project managing the implementation of IT systems and infrastructure for easyJet Station start-up in Bristol in January 2009 as well as other easyJet start-ups in Tenerife, Ibiza and Barcelona in November 2009.
Provided front line (on site and remote) support to all UK Cargo Terminals, including PC support and maintenance, network administration, exchange server administration, and answering user enquiries.
Developed via a Business Intelligence tool called IQ Objects, all reports generated from the core Cargo Handling System.
Assisted in administering, with the Quality Manager, Ogden Cargo's ISO 9002 Certified Quality System.
